title: Leap years
description:
Read a year and say whether it is a leap year. A year is a leap year if it divides by 4, except years that divide by 100, which are leap years only if they also divide by 400.

```
Year? 2024
2024 is a leap year
```

Otherwise print `<year> is not a leap year`.

starter.main.lua:
io.write("Year? ")
local year = io.read("n")
print(year .. " is a leap year")

solution.main.lua:
io.write("Year? ")
local year = io.read("n")
local leap = (year % 4 == 0 and year % 100 ~= 0) or year % 400 == 0
if leap then
    print(year .. " is a leap year")
else
    print(year .. " is not a leap year")
end

hints: `year % 4 == 0` tests "divides by 4". Combine the three conditions with `and`, `or` and `~=`.

examples.expected: Year? 2023 is not a leap year

tests.expected: Year? 2023 is not a leap year
Year? 1900 is not a leap year
